description.value:
Given a minute and bare earth, you stop being a thing that moves.

Gift — Root as a 1-minute action. While rooted, nothing short of a critical success moves you, and you gain +2 circumstance to Fortitude saves. Tithe — Rooted, your Speed is 0 and unrooting costs a full action. The GM is under no obligation to warn you that rooting was the wrong call.

cinderfall.incomplete: Being rooted also states 'nothing short of a critical success moves you' and 'your Speed is 0' -- no rule element grants immunity to forced movement conditioned on a self-toggled RollOption, and overriding land speed to exactly 0 while rooted has no confirmed real precedent (BaseSpeed's real usage only adds new movement types, e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/anadi/level-9/strand-strider.json, never zeroes land speed). The Fortitude bonus above is real and automated; the movement-lock is not.
